note_en: 之间 "between" and 后 "after" are postpositions: they come after the noun, not before it like English prepositions. In the text: 养老保险可以在不同城市之间转移 "pension insurance can be transferred between different cities" (literally "different cities between"); 退休后 "after retiring." When translating, flip the order: English "between" / "after" first, then what it refers to.
